يتلبرل (form IIq)
# يَتَلَبْرَلُ (yatalabralu) /ja.ta.lab.ra.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# يُتَلَبْرَلُ (yutalabralu) /ju.ta.lab.ra.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# يَتَلَبْرَلَ (yatalabrala) /ja.ta.lab.ra.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَ
